name: MKT_SR_HEADER
description: This table stores the Saved Result Set (SRS) header records across multiple marketing segmentation target levels.A SRS is a snapshot of segment members that are recorded at a particular point in time so that they can be reused in the future without re-evaluating the criteria again.

columns.name: GUID
columns.description: Unique identifier to identify the saved result set

columns.name: SEGMENT_PATH
columns.description: Path name of the segment report in the Oracle BI Web Catalog

columns.name: SR_CUSTOM_LABEL
columns.description: A user-created text literal for the saved result set

columns.name: PRIORITY
columns.description: Priority for a branch in the segment tree

columns.name: NODE_PATH
columns.description: Branch ID number for a branch in the segment tree

columns.name: NODE_LABEL
columns.description: Label text of a priority node in the segment tree

columns.name: TARGET_LEVEL
columns.description: Name of the target level for which the saved result is being created

columns.name: SR_CREATED_BY
columns.description: The user who created the saved result set

columns.name: SRS_COUNT
columns.description: Number of target level IDs in the Saved result set

columns.name: DATE_TIME
columns.description: Date and Time when the Saved result set was created

columns.name: SR_PATH
columns.description: Refers to the Saved result set list format that was used

columns.name: CONNECTION_POOL
columns.description: Connection pool that was used to write the saved result set
